Calls handler_table_19ec[object->state_3](object).

When field_46 reaches -1 or it is blocked, it increments state_3.

Loads field_68 and field_60 from pairs_80170074[field_61] and dispatches on field_61: func_8012ca04, func_8012cb3c, or func_8012c990/func_8012cac8/func_8012cc6c for 0xc, 0xd, 0x11 when field_60 is 2, else sets field_45 to 0xff, increments field_69 and calls func_801308c4 with field_68.

Otherwise copies field_158 to field_0b; if field_45 is nonzero sets field_60 to 3, field_45 to 0xff and calls func_801308c4 with 0x12 (then func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0). Else sets field_60 to 1, clears field_46, and calls func_8012c89c if field_cd is set, or func_801308c4 with 0xc or 0xe depending on field_157.

Clears field_157; uses index 0xc, or 0xe (incrementing field_157) if the other object's field_45 is 0 and its field_157 is nonzero. Calls func_801308c4 with the index and then func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.
Sets field_60 to 5, field_62 to 10, clears field_46 and field_157, copies field_158 to field_0b, calls func_801308c4 with 0xc, and calls func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.
If field_259 is 0, it increments it, calls func_80152b40, plays sound 0x321 with play_sound_at and calls func_801376b8. Always then sets field_15b to 1 and calls func_801308c4 with 0x13.

Calls func_80152d28 with the object, sets field_25a to 1 and calls func_801308c4 with 0x21.

Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.
Increments state_3, then calls func_8012d0bc (which plays side sound 0) and func_8012cf1c.

Calls func_8012eff8 on the object and sets state_3 to 2 if it returns nonzero.

Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.
